evidence.quote: For FIFO queues, concurrent invocations are capped either by the number of [message group IDs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/using-messagegroupid-property.html) (`messageGroupId`) or the maximum concurrency setting—whichever is lower. For example, if you have six message group IDs and maximum concurrency is set to 10, your function can have a maximum of six concurrent invocations.
